notes: The spinner shows the static dot under reduced motion or the internal accessibility flag; otherwise it renders one frame of the terminal-dependent cycle at the 120 ms quantum.
The animation clock rounds the interval up to the 16 ms quantum, floors now() onto that grid, and reads 0 while the interval is null, the clock is absent or the node is not visible.
Visibility is measured against the viewport rows minus ancestor scroll clamps; an unmeasurable node keeps the previous visible state.
HIe and Vdn select the xterm-ghostty frame set from TERM (default set otherwise); the full-repaint flag raises any interval below 480 ms to 480 ms.
The message lays the spinner and its text in a row and an optional dim subtitle in the column below.
